defect.problem: parallel_cite '93 L. Ed. 2d 1879' places a 1949 decision in the SECOND series of the Lawyers' Edition. The L. Ed. 2d series did not begin until the mid-1950s, so a case 'Decided June 27, 1949' (338 U.S. 160) cannot bear an 'L. Ed. 2d' cite; the correct parallel is '93 L. Ed. 1879' (first series). The lake citations[] propagate the identical 'L. Ed. 2d' error.
defect.proposed_fix: Change '93 L. Ed. 2d 1879' to '93 L. Ed. 1879' in frontmatter parallel_cite and in lake citations.parallel/all.
